final: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero) AS REAL) as percentage, SUM(CASE WHEN publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as marvel_bad_count FROM superhero JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE alignment.alignment = 'Bad'
